description: Glorp quarterly review: rate rises to $2.35 a crate from 2026-11-01; weighing Speedy Snail again
body: Glorp Logistics is raising its rate from $2.10 to $2.35 a crate from 2026-11-01. Asked Speedy Snail Couriers for a faster quote before deciding.

description: Started glow variant research: glowworm-free luminescence from moon algae
body: Started on the glow-in-the-dark variant. Glowworms are out; moon algae glow without them and taste of cucumber.
